name: kordu-probe
description: Cloudflare-native public connectivity diagnostics with TCP, DNS, HTTP, and IP checks.

scripts.build: bun run generate:agent-skills && bun run build:shared && bun run build:web && bun run build:api
scripts.dev:prepare: bun run generate:agent-skills && PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=1x00000000000000000000AA bun run build:web
scripts.dev: bun run dev:prepare && bun run dev:api
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:shared && bun run typecheck:web && bun run typecheck:api
scripts.lint: bunx eslint apps/api/src apps/api/test packages/shared/src scripts --ext .ts,.js,.mjs
scripts.test:web: cd apps/web && PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=1x00000000000000000000AA bunx astro build && bunx vitest run
scripts.test: bun run generate:agent-skills && bun run test:shared && bun run test:web && bun run test:api
